FORM NO. 3
C. 42M-1-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. .........

S.I. Special Branch /84/404/169
REPORT
Date August 11, 1938.

Subject (in full) Arther FELDMANN, Hungarian - communication dated 1.8.38.
from Netherlands Consulate-General.

Made by D.S. Pitts    Forwarded by E. Gauda J.J

Exhaustive enquiries made in various directions
in collaboration with D.I. Papp have failed to reveal any
information in regard to the present whereabouts of Arther
FELDMANN, Hungarian prisoner of war, who is said to have left
Russia for China.

It is respectfully suggested that copies of the
attached photograph of FELDMANN be made for record purposes,
prior to the original being returned.

（左侧批注：Copies attached. D.S. 78）

D.S. Pitts
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).

报告
日期：1938年8月11日。

事由（全称）亚瑟·费尔德曼（Arther FELDMANN），匈牙利人——荷兰总领事馆1938年8月1日来函。

呈报人：D.S. Pitts    转呈人：E. Gauda J.J

经与 D.I. Papp 协作，从多方面进行了详尽查询，但未能查明据称已从俄国前往中国的匈牙利战俘亚瑟·费尔德曼（Arther FELDMANN）目前的下落。

谨建议在将费尔德曼（FELDMANN）的原照归还之前，复印存档。

（左侧批注：附复印件。D.S. 78）

D.S. Pitts
D. S.

副督察长（特别处）。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.2211.

SHANGHAI, 1st August 1938. Date 3 / 8 / 38 2601

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I have been asked by
the Hungarian Government to make inquiries concerning a certain
Arthur FELDMANN, a Hungarian ex-prisoner of war, who according
to a certain Bela Tornyosi, repatriated in 1937, is said to have
left Russia and is supposed to have gone to China.

He is born at Kiskuncaujhely, 51 years of age, medium size,
light brown hair. There is a wide space between his two in-
cisors and a scar on one of his legs caused by a fall.

Exhaustive enquiries have been made in North China and
amongst the Hungarian community at Shanghai. None of the ex-
prisoners from Siberia residing in Manchuria or here appear
ever to have met this person and it seems doubtful that he
ever left Russia.

Before reporting however that this person cannot be lo-
cated, I thought it advisable to send you his photograph with
the request kindly to have it compared with those of persons
you have on record as it might be possible that for some reason
or other Feldmann has changed his identity.

Kindly return the enclosed photograph after you have made
use of it.

（批：PA. Acknowledge）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE - 2 AUG. 1938 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Consul-General for the Netherlands, tempora-
rily in charge of Hungarian Interests.

Major K.M.Bourne,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,

SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。

编号 2211。

上海，1938年8月1日。日期 3 / 8 / 38 2601

先生：

谨此告知，匈牙利政府请我就一名叫亚瑟·费尔德曼（Arthur FELDMANN）的匈牙利前战俘一事进行查询。据1937年遣返的贝拉·托尔尼奥西（Bela Tornyosi）称，此人据说已离开俄国，并推测已前往中国。

他出生于基什孔考伊豪洛姆（Kiskuncaujhely），现年51岁，中等身材，浅褐色头发。两颗门齿之间间隙较宽，一条腿上有一处因跌倒留下的疤痕。

已在华北及上海的匈牙利侨民中进行了详尽查询。居住在满洲或此地的来自西伯利亚的前战俘中，似乎无人曾见过此人，因此他是否真的离开过俄国也令人怀疑。

然而，在报告无法找到此人之前，我认为宜将其照片发送给阁下，并请 kindly 将其与贵处存档的人员照片进行比对，因为费尔德曼（Feldmann）可能出于某种原因改变了身份。

使用完毕后，请将所附照片退回。

（批：PA. 确认收悉）
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 - 1938年8月2日 警务处处长办公室）

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

荷兰总领事，
暂代匈牙利利益事务。

K.M. Bourne 少校，
警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局，

上海。
